scope: Exact receipt-only native program observer, its existing assessment interface, targeted local checks and installed host copy/configuration references. Ordinary runner, prompts and native quality rules unchanged.

truthfulObservationChain: Successful original main.py write with unchanged actor/session/workspace.
Finite literal direct Python command, optional exact cd /workspace prefix and simple safe data redirection.
Actual start PID, original same-session read_process_output exit receipt and retained exit code.
Independent final source readback hash equals the observed source.
Host replay of original receipt rows confirms the same write/start/exit bindings; foreign, duplicate or reordered scope/step evidence is not adopted.
uncertaintyRemainsUnclaimed: Arbitrary compound shell, heredoc, pipeline or mutator.
Failed or unconfirmed write; absent/wrong PID or actual exit receipt.
Schema listing presented as process exit.
Concurrent pending process, source change during execution, foreign session/workspace or final source mismatch.

consumerInterface.detail: The reader validates artifact_evidence as a dictionary and its complete canonical hash against trusted runbindings, without imposing a closed fieldset on execution rows. Extra PID/exit/write-receipt fields are retained and hashed; known execution fields and fixed scoring remain unchanged.

checks.qualification: The initial positive local chain and grouped negative node passed. The final source adds only conservative invalidation for an already pending process; that changed negative node passed on the final hash. The physical positive chain was not repeated. The initial source hash was independently reconstructed by removing precisely that added branch.
